verdict.rationale: Bento's docs mention revenue/conversion attribution back to an email or flow (bento-docs-6) and reviewing broadcast history via the API (bento-docs-34), implying some campaign-level reporting exists, but there is no documentation of opens, clicks, or unsubscribe metrics, nor any mention of per-automation-step analytics or time-series trending. missing for 10: explicit open/click/unsubscribe rate reporting, per-workflow-step breakdown, historical/time-series analytics views, and any dashboard or report screenshot evidence.
